name: Production Technology I
topics: Sand Casting: Patterns, Allowances, Moulding Sand
Explain the five pattern allowances and calculate the pattern dimensions for the given cast-iron casting with shrinkage allowance.
Explain types of patterns (including sweep patterns) with sketches; describe the sand-mould features and desirable properties of moulding sand.
Cores, Chaplets, Gating and Risers
What is the use of cores and chaplets in casting? Show with a sketch.
Explain the gating system and the importance of risers with a neat sketch.
Special Casting Processes
Explain centrifugal (true vs semi-centrifugal) and investment casting with sketches, advantages and disadvantages.
Explain cold-chamber die casting with a sketch; justify why casting is still a dominant process.
Gas Welding
Explain oxy-acetylene welding, its tools and the three flames with sketches.
How are the flames identified and what are the mixing ratios? Discuss welding positions.
Arc and Resistance Welding: SMAW, SAW, GMAW, TIG, Spot
Explain GMAW with a sketch, MIG vs MAG and modes of metal transfer; explain TIG welding and why it is preferred over MIG.
Explain submerged arc welding and resistance spot welding; discuss common SMAW defects and the role of electrode coating.
Advanced Welding: Electron Beam, Laser, Induction
Explain electron beam welding with a diagram and applications.
Differentiate electron-beam and laser-beam welding; explain induction welding for plastics and pipe seams.
Metal Forming: Forging, Extrusion, Wire Drawing
Differentiate hot and cold working; explain drop, roll, press and upset forging with sketches.
Explain wire drawing, intermediate annealing and lubrication; explain extrusion.
Powder Metallurgy
Explain the powder metallurgy process and the steps of powder production with a diagram.
Why are atomisation and sintering needed? Give the advantages and disadvantages of powder metallurgy.
Additive Manufacturing and 3D Printing
Explain the working of a 3D printer and the difference between 3D printing and additive manufacturing.
Explain selective laser sintering, the materials used and its issues.
Metrology and Inspection
Differentiate line and end standards and explain how length standards are transferred to end standards.
Explain slip gauges, limit and snap gauges; brief about radiography and ultrasonic testing.
